description: Reference verdicts for experimental hold_policy (docs/media-buy/task-reference/refine_proposals.mdx#hold-policy-experimental). Each finalize vector is a refine_proposals finalize request, the seller's records of the source drafts, the request and response times a grader observed, and the seller response or task-level error; each draft vector is a draft with its allocated products. expected.violations lists every rule the input breaks, using the codes in violation_codes; an empty list means conformant. The shape is experimental and may change with the feature.

conventions.duration: Durations are ISO 8601 day, hour, minute, and second parts only. A day is exactly 86400 seconds added to the UTC instant: no calendar, time-zone, or daylight-saving arithmetic. Durations are compared after normalizing to elapsed time, so P1D equals PT24H.
conventions.hold_placement: The hold is placed when the seller creates the committed proposal, and a committed proposal whose hold_policy.available is true records that instant in hold_placed_at. observation.request_received_at is when the seller received the finalize request and observation.response_at is when it responded or, for a submitted finalize, when the task completed; hold_placed_at must lie in that window. Callers below 3.3 receive no hold_placed_at. For them placement lies somewhere in the window, and a bound is a violation only when it fails for every placement in it; a bound that passes for some placements and fails for others is reported in expected.indeterminate and is not a violation.
conventions.bounds: For a holdable draft (effective available true) that declares them: expires_at >= placement + min_duration and expires_at <= placement + max_duration. A no-hold committed proposal has an acceptance window, not a hold, so neither bound applies.
conventions.effective_policy: A draft or product without hold_policy takes the seller hold_semantics: terms_only means { available: false }, and inventory_hold or absent means { available: true } with no durations and extendable false.
conventions.source_drafts: source_drafts are the seller's records of the drafts as it serves them at 3.3. Serving a caller below 3.3, the seller omits hold_policy on the wire, but the grader still resolves the effective policy from these records.
conventions.presence: A seller that lists media_buy.hold_policy includes hold_policy on every draft and committed proposal for callers at 3.3 or later. For callers below 3.3 it omits hold_policy and hold_placed_at from every product and proposal in the response.
conventions.draft_derivation: A holdable draft derives from its allocated products' effective policies: its min_duration and max_duration do not exceed the max_duration of any allocated product that declares one, its max_total_duration does not exceed that of any allocated product that declares one, and it is extendable only if every allocated product is extendable. Product policies are otherwise planning hints.
conventions.duration_order: Within one hold_policy, min_duration <= max_duration <= max_total_duration after normalizing. The schema cannot compare durations, so the grader checks this.
conventions.adcp_version: The caller version is request.adcp_version, compared by major and minor.

violation_codes.schema_invalid: A request, draft, product, response, or task error fails its JSON Schema. A grader reports only this code for the vector.
violation_codes.min_duration_not_honored: expires_at is earlier than placement + min_duration (for every possible placement when hold_placed_at is not on the wire).
violation_codes.max_duration_exceeded: expires_at is later than placement + max_duration (for every possible placement when hold_placed_at is not on the wire).
violation_codes.hold_placed_at_outside_window: A committed hold_placed_at is earlier than request_received_at or later than response_at.
violation_codes.hold_policy_not_carried_forward: A committed proposal hold_policy differs from its source draft hold_policy, including being added or dropped.
violation_codes.terms_digest_mismatch: A committed terms_digest is not the sha256 base64url digest of the RFC 8785 serialization of its commercial_terms.
violation_codes.commercial_terms_changed: A committed proposal commercial_terms differ from its source draft; finalize changes no terms.
violation_codes.experimental_feature_undeclared: A draft, committed proposal, or product carries hold_policy but the seller experimental_features omits media_buy.hold_policy.
violation_codes.hold_unavailable_without_hold: An entry whose effective policy has available false returns hold_unavailable.
violation_codes.batch_aborted_without_cause: An entry returns batch_aborted but no sibling entry failed for its own reason.
violation_codes.terms_only_committed_below_3_3: A committed proposal whose effective policy has available false is returned to a caller below AdCP 3.3.
violation_codes.hold_policy_sent_below_3_3: A product or proposal returned to a caller below AdCP 3.3 carries hold_policy or hold_placed_at.
violation_codes.unsupported_feature_without_cause: A finalize batch fails with UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE although the caller is at AdCP 3.3 or later or every draft is holdable, so the version gate does not apply.
violation_codes.hold_policy_missing: The seller lists media_buy.hold_policy and the caller is at AdCP 3.3 or later, but a draft or committed proposal omits hold_policy.
violation_codes.draft_exceeds_product_policy: A holdable draft promises more than an allocated product's effective policy: a min_duration or max_duration above a product max_duration, a max_total_duration above a product max_total_duration, or extendable true when a product is not extendable.
violation_codes.hold_policy_durations_unordered: A hold_policy has min_duration > max_duration or max_duration > max_total_duration after normalizing.
violation_codes.draft_available_inconsistent: A draft declares available true although an allocated product effective policy has available false.
